question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘A Fine Balance’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohinton Mistry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohinton Mistry**__ is the author of the book ‘A Fine Balance’.
 
• The book was published by McClelland and Stewart in 1995.
 
• The book won the Kiriyama Pacific Rim Book Prize for Fiction and the Canadian Authors Association Fiction Award.
 
• It was also shortlisted for the Booker Prize in 1996.
 
• The premise of the book is set in "an unidentified city" in India, initially in 1975 and later in 1984 during the turmoil of The Emergency.
 
• Other books by Rohinton Mistry- Such a long journey, Family Matters, The scream, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Books by Shashi Tharoor-The Paradoxical Prime Minister, Why I am a Hindu, Reasons of State, etc.
 
• Books by Amitav Ghosh- Sea of Poppies, The Hungry Tide, River of Smoke, etc.
 
• Books by Arvind Adiga- The White Tiger, Last Man in Tower, Selection Day, etc.
